about_the_game:
Idle Rat: Island Digger

Dig. Discover. Relax.

Help a clever little rat uncover the hidden secrets buried beneath a peaceful tropical island.
In this relaxing idle digging game, you’ll dig through layers of sand and stone, find treasures, and upgrade your tools to dig even deeper. Watch your progress unfold as your tiny rat companion tirelessly explores the underground world.

Whether you play actively or let the game run in the background, your little digger will keep working — slowly but surely uncovering more of the island’s mysteries.

Key Features

  • 🐀 Relaxing Idle Gameplay: Watch your rat dig automatically.

  • 💎 Treasure Hunting: Discover valuable items and hidden relics buried deep underground.

  • 🛠️ Upgradeable Tools: Improve your shovel, bag, and other gear to dig faster and reach new depths.

  • 🌴 Peaceful Atmosphere: Enjoy calming pixel-art visuals.

  • 🪟 Always on Top Mode: Play it over any app — freely move and resize the window for your perfect setup.

Idle Rat: Island Digger is all about slowing down, relaxing, and watching small progress grow into something rewarding.

Sit back, dig deep, and enjoy the cozy rhythm of discovery. 🌊
